# Relay CLI plumbing: registration validation, safe listings and typed
# failures stay local; no owner endpoint is probed by any command here.
mkdir local
exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space creative --remote one --drive-id drive --root-id root --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'

# target-set names every missing binding element before reading credentials.
! exec drivebridge relay target-set images --state $WORK/state
stderr 'command_failed'

exec sh -c 'printf fixture-owner-key > key'
chmod 0600 key

# Unknown owners and non-loopback plain-http origins are rejected locally.
! exec drivebridge relay target-set images --state $WORK/state --space creative --project p --connection laptop --url http://storage.example.com --key-file $WORK/key --owner eikona
stderr 'invalid_relay_target'
! exec drivebridge relay target-set tracks --state $WORK/state --space creative --project p --connection laptop --url https://music.example.com --key-file $WORK/key --owner ordo
stderr 'invalid_relay_target'

# A key file readable by others is refused.
exec sh -c 'printf fixture-owner-key > open.key'
chmod 0644 open.key
! exec drivebridge relay target-set images --state $WORK/state --space creative --project p --connection laptop --url https://images.example.com --key-file $WORK/open.key
stderr 'private_token_file_required'

# Loopback http and https origins register without probing; listings show
# only safe binding facts.
exec drivebridge relay target-set images --state $WORK/state --space creative --project p --connection laptop --url http://127.0.0.1:8443 --key-file $WORK/key --owner eikona
stdout 'Relay target registered'
exec drivebridge relay target-set shots --state $WORK/state --space creative --project p --connection laptop --url https://shots.example.com --key-file $WORK/key --owner scaena
stdout 'Relay target registered'
exec drivebridge relay targets --state $WORK/state --json
stdout '"id":"images"'
stdout '"owner":"scaena"'
! stderr .

# The same id with a different binding stays a conflict.
! exec drivebridge relay target-set images --state $WORK/state --space creative --project other --connection laptop --url https://images.example.com --key-file $WORK/key --owner sonora
stderr 'relay_target_conflict'

# Start and cancel surface typed codes and exit non-zero for unknown ids.
! exec drivebridge relay start drivebridge://file/missing --target images --idempotency-key one --state $WORK/state
stderr 'reference_not_found'
! exec drivebridge relay start drivebridge://file/missing --target nowhere --idempotency-key one --state $WORK/state
stderr 'relay_target_unavailable'
! exec drivebridge relay cancel does-not-exist --state $WORK/state
stderr 'operation_not_found'

# Disabling removes a target from use; the row stays inspectable.
exec drivebridge relay target-disable images --state $WORK/state --json
stdout '"disabled":true'
